Exchanges.Text: Good morning, Gate team-b. Our sprint goal is “Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically,” and there are 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, for story 3, story 4, task 15, and task 19, are those done as you committed three standups ago after the idempotency keys?
What have you finished, what’s next, and is anything blocking you, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests today.

Story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your update.

Task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, has been Active for 2 days. Still on track?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Thanks, Daniel. Maya, is story 5 done from “I’ll chase them today,” is bug 12 done from pairing on staging access, and is story 2 done from continuing settlement file validation?
What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline and I will add it to the parking lot, then Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Who can help unblock this access to the platform team’s staging gateway?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: you’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

For story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, it has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker is waiting on the security review and your commitment is to chase them today; blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya.
Admin, is story 1 done from the payment retry work, and is task 14 done? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted your commitment: Keep working on the payment retry story today.

Task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slipped because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Admin, who can help unblock this issue where the sandbox was down?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll sync with Maya after the stand-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Quick recap: blockers raised were that task 19 may slip if the idempotency keys take longer, access is blocked to the platform team’s staging gateway, the security review is still pending, and the sandbox was down. We parked an offline topic about the gateway timeouts side discussion between Daniel Park and Admin. Nobody was absent, nobody failed to respond, and there were no flagged items left uncovered. Follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who did not respond, are coming in Teams. Thank you, everyone.
